_comment: Reference values for xtb-singlepoint-gfn2 (xtb 6.7.1, GFN2-xTB single point on acetonitrile). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: xtb 6.7.1 official grimme-lab binary release (sha256-pinned in Dockerfile), OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (spread 0). Cross-verify: verifier re-runs the same single point on the pinned asset geometry; bit-identical, tol 1e-8 Eh.
